REQ-CON-01.title: Hyper-Local Store Discovery
REQ-CON-01.description: Consumers discover open neighborhood retail stores within a 500m-2km radius based on real-time location.

REQ-CON-02.title: Zero-Phantom Realtime Inventory
REQ-CON-02.description: Real-time synchronization ensures listed items are physically in stock, with buffer thresholds to prevent walk-in collisions.

REQ-CON-03.title: Transparent Honest Billing
REQ-CON-03.description: Flat, transparent pricing with zero surge fees, zero dark convenience charges, and clear delivery fee breakdowns.

REQ-CON-04.title: Live Order Progress Tracking
REQ-CON-04.description: Live status updates through Placed, Packed, Out for Delivery, and Delivered stages with estimated turnaround time.

REQ-CON-05.title: Automated Photo Dispute & Refund
REQ-CON-05.description: Consumers capture item defect photos at delivery to trigger immediate escrow-backed wallet refunds without human call-center queues.

REQ-MER-01.title: Barcode Stock Intake Terminal
REQ-MER-01.description: Lightweight mobile camera scanner for instant SKU barcode ingestion, price adjustment, and active stock counts.

REQ-MER-02.title: Loud Real-Time Order Dispatch Terminal
REQ-MER-02.description: Real-time order receiver with audio alerts, order packing checklist, and countdown acceptance timer.

REQ-MER-03.title: Capacity Manager & Busy Mode
REQ-MER-03.description: Store capacity monitor with manual or automatic Busy Mode toggle to prevent order backlogs during rush hours.

REQ-MER-04.title: Digital Escrow Payout Ledger
REQ-MER-04.description: Replaces traditional credit (udhari) with instant digital settlements directly to merchant bank accounts upon delivery verification.

REQ-OPS-01.title: Dynamic Peak-Load Spillover Engine
REQ-OPS-01.description: Automatically reroutes incoming orders to nearby partner stores within 1.2km when a store hits capacity or toggles Busy Mode.

REQ-OPS-02.title: Quality Governance & 3-Strike Rule
REQ-OPS-02.description: Digital escrow withholding for disputed orders and automated strike penalty tracking for chronic defect offenders.

REQ-DLV-01.title: Store Staff Delivery Terminal
REQ-DLV-01.description: Mobile interface for in-store delivery staff showing customer address, navigation coordinates, and order item list.

REQ-DLV-02.title: Dual Handoff Verification (OTP/Photo)
REQ-DLV-02.description: Secure doorstep delivery completion verified by customer 4-digit OTP or geotagged delivery proof photo.
